scripts.test: cd ../.. && npm run build && vitest run
scripts.dev: cd ../.. && npm run build && cd tools/smart-sub && wrangler dev worker.js --port 8787
scripts.predeploy: cd ../.. && npm run build && vitest run
scripts.deploy: mkdir -p /tmp/vpn-sub-deploy && cp worker.js /tmp/vpn-sub-deploy/_worker.js && wrangler pages deploy /tmp/vpn-sub-deploy --project-name your-pages-project --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:backup: cd ../.. && npm run build && cd tools/backup-sub && vercel deploy --prod --yes
scripts.version:check: node -e "const v = require('./package.json').version; const w = require('fs').readFileSync('worker.js','utf8').match(/worker_version:\s*[\"']([\d.]+)/)[1]; if(v!==w){console.error('Version mismatch: package.json='+v+' worker.js='+w);process.exit(1)}else{console.log('✅ Versions match: '+v)}"
